reactions.name: Synthesis of Zr-NU-1000-O₂CH (200 mg)
reactions.plain_text_description:
Purpose: Try the 200 mg scale method to obtain pure Zr-NU-1000
Reference: Nat. Protocol. (200 mg)
Analysis
PXRD: (A) Zr-NU-1000 (100 peak weak; Zr-NU-901?) (B) Zr-NU-1000
Conclusion
One batch out of two was successful.

Procedure
Reaction
2 x 100 mL screw bottles + red PBT/silicone/PTFE caps (A, B)
Add ZrOCl₂·8H₂O (388.1 mg, 389.4 mg)
Add benzoic acid (10.834 g, 10.826 g)
Add DMF
Sonicate until fully dissolved
Heat at 80 °C for 1 h → clear solution [Do not exceed 1 h]
Cool down in a water bath, ≤30 min
Add H₄TBAPy (160.2 mg, 160.4 mg)
Sonicate for 20 min → uniform suspension
Heat at 100 °C (the grid was covered by aluminium foil!) for 18 h [15.5 h] → light yellow precipitation
Cool down to RT
reactions.plain_text_observation:
Centrifuge (7750 × g, 5 min) → Discard the supernatant
Add DMF (45 mL)
Soak for 2 h
Centrifuge → Discard the supernatant
Repeat three times in total.
Transfer the solid into a bottle containing 52 mL DMF.
Add 2 mL of 8 M HCl (aq) and mix gently.
Heat the mixture at 100 °C for 14 h.
Cool the reaction mixture to room temperature
Centrifuge → Discard the supernatant
Add 45 mL DMF
Soak for 2 h
Centrifuge → Discard the supernatant
Repeat three times in total.
Add 45 mL acetone
Soak for 12 h, then centrifuge.
Repeat the acetone exchange three times in total. [Correct it]
Dry the sample in the oven at 80 °C for 1 h.
Weigh (1190 mg, 1251 mg)

reactions.name: Synthesis of Zr-NU-1000-O₂CH (seeding)
reactions.plain_text_description:
Purpose: (A) Characterize the Zr-NU-1000 sample by N2 sorption. (B) Try seeding to obtain pure Zr-NU-1000 reproducibly. 
References: MS-R11; 10.1021/jacs.6b01414 (seeding of PCN-222/224)
Analysis
PXRD: Zr-NU-1000 (A: 100 peak little weak. B: 100 peak weak, Zr-NU-901 or guest?. C: No peak at 4.4°)
N2 sorption: uptake ca. 40% of HSH-040/052
Conclusion
Seeding cannot prevent Zr-NU-901 formation.
Either product A contains non-porous amorphous impurities or N2 sorption measurement went wrong.

Procedure
Reaction
3 x 100 mL bottle + red PBT/silicone/PTFE cap (A–C)
Add ZrOCl₂·8H₂O ( 388.2		 389.3		 388.5  mg)
Add BzOH (10.84		10.828		10.815 g)
B: Add Zr-NU-1000 (Kirti)
Add DMF
Sonicate until fully dissolved.
Heat at 80 °C for 1 h.
Cool down (≤30 min)
Add H₄TBAPy (160.5 		160.2 		161.1 mg)
Sonicate for 20 min to disperse the ligand.
Heat at 100 °C for 15.5 h → light-yellow precipitate forms.
Cool down to RT
reactions.plain_text_observation:

reactions.name: Synthesis of Zr-NU-1000-formate (2 g)
reactions.plain_text_description:
Purpose: Preparation of Zr-NU-1000 for catalysis tests.
References: MS-R13A,C; 2 → 6 batches
Analysis
Weighing: 125% yield
PXRD-X1–7: no peak at 4.4° in X2,X3,X4,X7, high-angle shifted vs X1,X5,X6 ← because of residual acetone
PXRD-2A–F: strong 100 signal, very weak peak at 4.4° ← because of residual acetone
PXRD-3: matching HSH-052
Digestion 1H NMR ref: DMF, HCO2, Me2ND, acetone-d5/4 → Acetone proton exchange is quite fast, within 20 min, even after dilution
Digestion 1H NMR 2A_20s: 2 TBAPy, 2.4 formate, 0.66 BzOH, 0.14 DMF, 0.12 acetone-d5/4. 3350 g/mol (S/N = 453 for formate)
Digestion 1H NMR 2A vs 2B_10s: formate/TBAPy ratios match within 3% → 425 µL D2O is enough for dilution
Digestion 1H NMR 2C_12s vs 24s: TBAPy/formate signal 6% weaker than D1 = 24 → D1 should be ≥24 for zg30, ≥ 40 for zg
Digestion 1H NMR 2A_20s vs 2C_12s: TBAPy/formate lower in 2C by more than 10% → Brief sonication was not enough.
Digestion 1H NMR 2C vs 2D: DMSO gives sharper signals. Acetone protons are still exchanged.
Digestion 1H NMR 3B_24s vs 48s: TBAPy/formate does not differ more than 1% from D1 = 24 → D1 = 24 is enough in NaOD/D2O/DMSO. Can be 12?
Digestion 1H NMR 3B_24s: DMSO2_d5 → DMSO2 protons are exchanged by NaOD.
N2 sorption-3: 47% uptake at P/P0 = 0.40 compared to HSH-040
SEM-3: Hexagonal rods (5–7 µm length, 1.0–1.6 µm across flats, dislocations in the central part), a few irregular particles
TGA-3: residual mass 89.8% at 400 °C, 26.2% at 750 °C, 26.0% at 900 °C (HSH-040: 89.9% at 400 °C, 37.5% at 750 °C) (70% residual mass in comparison) (theoretical: 33% → 79% purity)
Conclusions
All 6 batches somehow gave Zr-NU-1000 with less Zr-NU-901 than in MS-R13 or MS-R11.
Solution 1H NMR analysis should be done with DMSO + sonication 30 min (acetone); NaOD/D2O + sonication 30 min + DMSO (formate, should be checked with D2O as well); and DMSO + D2SO4 (5%) + sonication (others) using durene as internal standard. (durene adsorption should be checked by durene/DMSO peak ratio)

Procedure
Reaction
6 × 100 mL bottles + red PBT/silicone/PTFE caps (A–F)
Weigh in ZrOCl2·8H2O (388.3, 388.6, 388.2, 388.1, 388.4, 388.9 mg)
Add BzOH (10.83, 10.822, 10.804, 10.811, 10.824, 10.834 mg)
Add DMF
Sonicate until fully dissolved.
Heat at 80 °C for 1 h
Cool down (≤30 min)
Add H₄TBAPy (160.6, 160.3, 161.3, 160.2, 160.8, 160.9 mg)
Sonicate for 20 min; observe dispersion
Heat at 100 °C (the grid was covered by aluminium foil!) for 15.5 h; observe light-yellow precipitation
Cool down to RT

reactions.plain_text_description:
Data lost and recreated from MS-R5

Purpose: Production of Zr-NU-1000-(O2CH)3(OH)(OH2) for catalysis
Reference: paper; AD-R2 → pure H4TBAPy; HSH-052
Analysis
PXRD: Zr-NU-1000 (100 peak weak: guest or NU-901. broad)
Digestion 1H NMR: formate, TBAPy, BzO, Me2ND
SEM-EDX: small prisms, some dents in the middle
Conclusions
Too fast nucleation.
The cap should be changed.

Procedure
Reaction
100 mL screw bottle with PP cap [Next time PBT/silicone/PTFE cap]
Add H₄TBAPy
Add DMF 40 mL 
Sonicated until uniformly suspended
Heat at 100 °C for 1 h (glassware oven @0.830) → clear solution [next time use UN30]
[Next time, cool down according to HSH-052]

500 mL screw bottle with PP cap [Next time PBT/silicone/PTFE cap]
Weigh in ZrOCl₂·8H₂O and BzOH.
Add DMF 120 mL
Sonicate until dissolved
Heat at 100 °C for 1 h (Oven @0.830) [next time use UN30]
Add the 100 mL-bottle content (in fume hood)
Shake
Heat at 120 °C for 16 h (convection oven Carbolite Gero PFSC30 (the grid was covered by aluminium foil!)) → Yellow precipitation [solution color: colorless ?]
Cool down to RT
